text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Driven purely by her refusal to lose, she 
held her ground. Gritting her teeth with a 
look of sheer desperation, Tosen Jordan 
powered through the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, Gold Ship told her, "Just 
stay an idiot, alright?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan, however, took it at face 
value and pouted in a huff. Their showdown 
would be carried over to the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the final stage of the Senior Spring 
Triple Crown, let us hone her greatest 
weapon.
